create_theilsenregressor: create a TheilSenRegressor instance with random_state for outlier-robust linear regression
create_linearregression: create a LinearRegression (OLS) estimator and fit it to synthetic data for comparison
create_ransacregressor: create a RANSACRegressor instance with random_state for robust regression against outliers
run_theilsen_fit_predict: run TheilSenRegressor.fit on feature matrix X and target y, then predict with .predict
run_ols_fit_predict: run LinearRegression.fit on feature matrix X and target y, then predict with .predict
